item.description: The ClaudeSDKClient.query() method incorrectly handles AsyncIterable prompts by assigning the coroutine function directly to transport._prompt instead of properly managing the AsyncIterable.
item.contract: When an AsyncIterable is passed to ClaudeSDKClient.query(), it should properly configure the transport to handle streaming without breaking the async iteration protocol. The transport's _prompt attribute should be an AsyncIterable instance that supports __aiter__ method, not a coroutine function.
item.acceptance: Tests that previously failed with "TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine" should pass, specifically: - tests/test_streaming_client.py::TestClaudeSDKClientStreaming::test_concurrent_send_receive - tests/test_streaming_client.py::TestClaudeSDKClientStreaming::test_receive_messages - tests/test_streaming_client.py::TestClaudeSDKClientEdgeCases::test_receive_response_list_comprehension - tests/test_streaming_client.py::TestClaudeSDKClientStreaming::test_receive_response - tests/test_integration.py::TestIntegration::test_simple_query_response - tests/test_integration.py::TestIntegration::test_continuation_option - tests/test_integration.py::TestIntegration::test_query_with_tool_use - tests/test_client.py::TestQueryFunction::test_query_with_cwd

item.description: The SubprocessCLITransport._stream_to_stdin method requires proper handling of AsyncIterable objects to support async iteration protocol correctly.
item.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method must properly validate and iterate over AsyncIterable prompts using the async for protocol. It should ensure that when _prompt is an AsyncIterable, it correctly implements the async iteration contract.
